mapper.select: select c1.C_Name as cName, c1.C_Abbreviation as cAbbName, mn.* from Sec_Quotation_Unit mn left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.C_Id = c1.C_Id where mn.Sir_Id = #{id} order by mn.squ_Amt ASC

select sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Type as secType, sec.Sec_Organize_Form as secOrganizeForm, sec.Sec_Bidding_Type as secBiddingType, sec.Sec_Start_Time as secStartTime, sec.Sec_Bidding_Cycle as secBiddingCycle, sec.Sec_Place as secPlace, sec.Sec_Money as secMoney, c1.C_Name as tendereeName, c1.C_Abbreviation as tendereeAbbName, c2.C_Name as sirIntendedUnitName, c2.C_Abbreviation as sirIntendedUnitAbbName, c6.C_Name as secAgencyName, f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId, pre.P_Name as pName, pre.p_Category as pCategory, pre.P_Build_Model as pBuildModel, case when pre.ppr_id is not null and pre.State != 7 then '1' else '0' end as reserveItems, mn.* from Sec_Inquiry_Record mn left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_ID = sec.Sec_Tenderee left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_ID = mn.Sir_Intended_Unit left join Sys_Company c6 on c6.C_Id = sec.Sec_Agency left join pre_project pre on pre.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileId = mn.id where mn.id = #{id}

select sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Type as secType, sec.Sec_Organize_Form as secOrganizeForm, sec.Sec_Bidding_Type as secBiddingType, sec.Sec_Start_Time as secStartTime, sec.Sec_Bidding_Cycle as secBiddingCycle, sec.Sec_Place as secPlace, c1.C_Name as tendereeName, c1.C_Abbreviation as tendereeAbbName, c2.C_Name as sirIntendedUnitName, c2.C_Abbreviation as sirIntendedUnitAbbName, mn.* from Sec_Inquiry_Record mn left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_ID=sec.Sec_Tenderee left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_ID=mn.Sir_Intended_Unit where mn.Sec_Id = #{secId} and mn.State = 7 order by mn.State_Time desc limit 1

select ${selectClause} from Sec_Inquiry_Record mn left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_ID=sec.Sec_Tenderee left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_ID=mn.Sir_Intended_Unit left join pre_project pre on pre.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Department dpre on dpre.D_Id = pre.p_Competent_Department left join Sec_Bidding_Plan sbp on sbp.Bp_Id=sec.Bp_Id left join ( select sp1.Sec_Id, sp1.P_ID, pro1.P_Name, pro1.p_Category, pro1.P_Build_Model, dpre1.D_Name from Sec_Project sp1 inner join pre_project pro1 on pro1.P_Id = sp1.P_Id left join SYS_Department dpre1 on dpre1.D_Id = pro1.p_Competent_Department where not exists ( select 1 from Sec_Project sp2 inner join pre_project pro2 on pro2.P_Id = sp2.P_Id where sp2.Sec_Id = sp1.Sec_Id and pro2.P_Create_Time > pro1.P_Create_Time )) sp on sp.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id ${authSql}

choose.when: and ( (case when pre.P_Name is null then sp.P_Name else pre.P_Name end) is null or (case when pre.P_Name is null then sp.P_Name else pre.P_Name end) = '' )
choose.otherwise:
and (case when pre.P_Name is null then sp.P_Name else pre.P_Name end) in
#{pName}

choose.when: and ( (case when pre.P_Category is null then sp.p_Category else pre.P_Category end) is null or (case when pre.P_Category is null then sp.p_Category else pre.P_Category end) = '' )
choose.otherwise:
and (case when pre.P_Category is null then sp.p_Category else pre.P_Category end) in
#{pCategory}

mapper.select: select c1.C_Name as cName, c1.C_Abbreviation as cAbbName, mn.* from Sec_Quotation_Unit mn left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.C_Id = c1.C_Id where mn.Sir_Id = #{sirId}
